ads_get_connection_status:
## ads_get_connection_status

Whether the seller's Amazon Ads account(s) are connected — a seller may hold SEVERAL Ads authorizations — and the list of ad profiles (stores/marketplaces) with their ids. Use the profile id as store_scope for every other ads tool; each profile names the connection (account) it belongs to.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
data_list_tables:
## data_list_tables

START HERE whenever the user asks anything about their Amazon business — 销量/订单/广告花费/ACOS/库存/退货/换货/利润/流量 (sales, orders, ad spend, inventory, returns, exchanges, profit, traffic). Lists the SQL tables in this seller's REAL store extract (orders, inventory, returns, replacements = FBA exchanges, ads daily metrics, finance, restock engine outputs) with row counts and descriptions. Use data_describe_table for columns, then data_query to run SQL.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
data_sync_start:
## data_sync_start

Sync ALL account data from Amazon SP-API into the store extract: orders, inventory, returns, FBA exchanges, finance (fees, settlements, reimbursements), traffic reports, storage costs, listings, buy box, sales rank and the rest. Runs in the background — poll data_sync_status; when runs succeed, data_query sees the fresh data automatically. Use when the seller wants up-to-date numbers. (Ads reports sync separately via ads_start_sync.)

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
data_sync_status:
## data_sync_status

Status of the account's data syncs: the latest run per kind (orders, inventory, returns, finance, insights) with success/failure and row counts, plus when the SQL extract was last built. Poll after data_sync_start.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
meta_get_usage:
## meta_get_usage

This account's own MCP usage and balance: calls and credits used per day over the last 30 days, and credits left. Use when the seller asks how much they have used or have left.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
meta_list_stores:
## meta_list_stores

All stores connected to this account, with the store_scope id to pass to other tools: Amazon Ads profiles (for ads_* tools) and the Amazon store connection (for restock_* tools). Each Amazon store's label is its store name — use it when confirming with the seller which store they mean.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
meta_list_workflows:

The seller's saved workflows (with schedules and last run) plus the builtin templates available to save.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{

}
```
restock_get_awd_status:
## restock_get_awd_status

AWD 上游仓配全貌（实时，只读）: 一次调用给出 AWD 库存、入库货件、补货单、出库单各 ≤25 条。没用 AWD 的店铺返回 in_use=false 并说明。AWD 是 FBA 之前的亚马逊低成本大宗仓，与 FBA 库存（inventory 表）和 FBA 入库（restock_* 货件工具）是两回事。

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
restock_get_hygiene:
## restock_get_hygiene

Restock data hygiene: unmapped SKUs, missing reference entries and other issues that silently distort the plan.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
restock_get_inbound_settings:
## restock_get_inbound_settings

FBA inbound shipment prerequisites in one read: ship-from address, contact, packing specs (which styles lack carton dims) and SKU mappings (which styles lack a seller SKU), plus whether the SP-API grant covers inbound at all (inbound_access). Call this FIRST before creating a shipment — `ready: false` means restock_preview_shipment would reject rows; fix gaps with restock_set_inbound_settings.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
restock_get_reference_summary:
## restock_get_reference_summary

Row counts of the seller-maintained reference tables (SKU mapping, seasonal index, box specs …) — the quickest completeness check for restock setup.

### 输入参数（JSON Schema）

```json
{
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```
